initial_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a production-ready transparent decal icon for the small wooden sign of a cozy farming game livestock barn. Primary request: ONE exceptionally clean, elegant silhouette of a domestic dairy COW, full body in a natural standing side profile, facing LEFT. True transparent background. Single solid warm dark brown ink (#70452c), smooth crisp antialiased outline, no internal shading, no woodgrain. Anatomically convincing compact broad rounded bovine muzzle, short thick neck, gently rounded substantial torso, four correctly articulated slender legs with flat cloven-hoof shapes and clear negative-space separation, a small recognizable udder, modest curved bovine horns and lateral ears, long thin tail with a small hair tuft. Balanced pastoral farm-sign logo, approachable cozy stylization while unmistakably a cow, professional graphic design. Whole animal centered with generous clear margins; body occupies about 80% canvas width; do not crop horns, hooves, or tail. Avoid stretched sausage torso, horse head, donkey ears, pig snout, oversized horns, heavy block legs, extra legs, outlines around the silhouette, gradients, highlights, 3D rendering, scenery, plaque, text, wheat, decorative frame, shadows, floor, checkerboard pattern, watermark. Output just the cow on actual alpha transparency.
final_edit_prompt: Precise-object-edit of the supplied cow icon. Preserve its cow anatomy, left-facing standing pose, horns, ears, udder, all four legs, tail and overall composition. Correct ONLY the rendering: replace the hazy translucent appearance with a perfectly opaque SOLID flat warm dark brown (#70452c) silhouette. Remove ALL glow, blur, bloom, haze, feathered shadow, cast shadow, gradients and internal highlights. The silhouette must have a crisp clean vector-like contour, antialiasing limited to the outermost single-pixel edge. Everything outside the cow must be fully transparent alpha=0, including between legs and around horns/tail. Inside the cow must be alpha=255. No black backdrop, no checkerboard, no text, no frame, no scenery. This is a tiny game sign decal, clarity and true transparency are mandatory.
packing: Native GIMP 3 resize to 384 x 256 centered inside 512 x 256 canvas; original shape and alpha preserved
